def calculate_sum_set_size(T):
    """
    Calculates the size of the sum set S = { t_i + t_j | 0 <= i <= j <= N-1 }
    where T is the list of elements.
    """
    N = len(T)
    S = set()
    for i in range(N):
        for j in range(i, N):
            S.add(T[i] + T[j])
    return len(S)
